@startuml

class Customer {
  + name : string
  + phoneNumber : string
  + email : string
}

class Driver {
  + driverId : int
  + firstName : string
  + lastName : string
  + vehicleNumber : int
}

class Car {
  + carId : int
  + ownerName : string
  + isSoberCar : boolean
}

class RideHailRequest {
  + requestId : int
  + pickupTime : datetime
  + dropOffTime : datetime
  + pickupLocation : string
  + dropOffLocation : string
  + rideDuration : time
  + distance : float
  + numberOfPassengers : int
  + fee : double
  + requestType : string
  + leadCustomerName : string
}

class RideShareRequest {
  + requestId : int
  + pickupTime : datetime
  + dropOffTime : datetime
  + pickupLocation : string
  + dropOffLocation : string
  + rideDuration : time
  + distance : float
  + customerNames : string[]
  + upfrontFee : double
}

class Accident {
  + accidentId : int
  + date : datetime
  + location : string
  + damageAmount : double
}

Customer "1" -- "0..*" RideHailRequest
Customer "1" -- "0..*" RideShareRequest

Car "1" -- "0..*" RideHailRequest
Car "1" -- "0..*" RideShareRequest
Car "1" -- "0..*" Accident

@enduml
